newsitem.title: USA: Citizens Bancshares names McBane chairman.
newsitem.headline: Citizens Bancshares names McBane chairman.

text.p: Citizens Bancshares said on Thursday it named Vice Chairman James McBane as company chairman.
The position had been vacant after the death of Chairman Raymond Lowry on May 21, Citizens said in a statement.
McBane, 56, was the chief executive officer of McBane Insurance Agency and has served as director since 1964.
Citizens said its board also named President and Chief Executive Officer Marty Adams vice chairman.
Adams would continue to hold the other positions and both men would remain on the board, it said.
